PG 17 §13.3.2: 'Row-level locks are released at transaction end or during savepoint rollback, just like table-level locks.' FOR UPDATE: 'other transactions that attempt UPDATE, DELETE, SELECT FOR UPDATE ... of these rows will be blocked until the current transaction ends'. 'Row-level locks ... block only writers and lockers to the same row.' Supports s6 'every other request that tries to change that order would wait'. (WebFetch summary, quoted as returned.)
